cards.name: Shadow of Dwimorberg
cards.text: Dusk. Shadow of Dwimorberg gets +2 [threat].  Midnight. Shadow of Dwimorberg gets +4 [threat].

cards.name: Midnight
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, place 1 progress on Midnight. Then, raise each player's threat by the number of progress on Midnight.

cards.name: Banks of Morthond
cards.text: While Banks of Morthond is the active location, each location in the staging area gets -1 [threat]
cards.shadow: Shadow: If this attack destroys a character, add 1 progress to the current Night objective.

cards.name: Eventide
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, place 1 progress on Eventide.  If there are 4 or more progress on Eventide, add it to the victory display and put Dusk into play.

cards.name: Whisperer
cards.text:
Spectral.
Dusk. Whisperer gets +1 [threat].  Midnight. Whisperer gets +2 [threat] and gains doomed 2.

cards.name: The Dead Ride Behind
cards.text: When Revealed: Deal 1 damage to each character with less than 2 [willpower] (Dusk. less than 3 [willpower] instead. Midnight. less than 4 [willpower] instead).

cards.name: Restless Dead
cards.text:
Spectral.
When Revealed: Return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to the staging area.

cards.name: Groping Horror
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player must choose: skip the next travel phase, or each player must pass his hand to the player on his left (discard your hand instead if you are the only player in the game).  Midnight. Groping Horror gains surge.

cards.name: Haunted Valley
cards.text: While this location is in the staging area, all ready heroes lose all [lore], [leadership], [spirit], and [tactics] icons.  Planning Action: Exhaust a hero. Any player may trigger this action.

cards.name: Relic from the Dark Years
cards.text: Midnight. Action: Claim this objective and attach it to a hero you control. Counts as an Artifact attachment with the text: "When attached hero attacks an Oathbreaker, that enemy loses the Spectral keyword until the end of the phase."

cards.name: The Lord of the Dead
cards.text:
Spectral. Cannot have attachments.
While you are engaged with The Lord of the Dead, treat all printed text boxes on characters you control as if they were blank (except for Traits).

cards.name: The Stone of Erech
cards.text:
Immune to player card effects. X is twice the number of players in the game.
While The Stone of Erech is the active location, characters with less than 2 [willpower] cannot ready.  Travel: Exhaust each character with less than 2 [willpower].

cards.name: Tarlang's Neck
cards.text: While Tarlang's Neck is the active location, it gains, "Forced: At the beginning of the encounter phase, the players must either immediately end the encounter phase, or the first player must engage all enemies in the staging area."

cards.name: Shadow-man
cards.text:
Spectral.
When Revealed: Players cannot play events until the end of the round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (Dusk. +2 [attack] instead. Midnight. +3 [attack] instead)

cards.name: Shadow Host Captain
cards.text:
Spectral.
Dusk. Shadow Host Captain gets +1 [attack] and +1 [defense].  Midnight. Shadow Host Captain gains +2 [attack] and +2 [defense].

cards.name: Midnight Throng
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player must search the encounter deck and discard pile for an Undead enemy, reveal it, and add it to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.  Midnight. This effect cannot be canceled.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Attacking enemy gets +1 [attack] (Dusk. +2 [attack] instead. Midnight. +3 [attack] instead)

cards.name: Vale of Shadows
cards.text: When Revealed: Make Vale of Shadows the active location. If another location is currently active, return it to the staging area.  Dusk. Vale of Shadows gets +2 quest points.  Midnight. Vale of Shadows gets +4 quest points.

cards.name: Driven by Fear
cards.text: When Revealed: The first player attaches Driven by Fear to a hero he controls. Counts as a Condition attachment with the text: "Attached character's [willpower] is reduced to 0. Treat attached character's text box as if it was blank (except for Traits.)"

cards.name: The Gloaming
cards.text:
Surge.
When Revealed: Add 1 progress to the current Night objective.

cards.name: Dusk
cards.text: Forced: At the end of the round, place 1 progress on Dusk.  If there are 4 or more progress on Dusk, add it to the victory display and put Midnight into play.

cards.name: The Disappearance
cards.text: Setup: Make Tarlang's Neck the active location. Set Derufin, The Lord of the Dead, The Stone of Erech, and the 3 Night objectives aside, out of play. Shuffle the encounter deck. Place Eventide into play, next to the current quest.
cards.back_text: When Revealed: Reveal 1 encounter card per player, adding them to the staging area.  Players cannot defeat this stage while Tarlang's Neck is in play.

cards.name: Terror of the Dead
cards.text: When Revealed: Add The Stone of Erech to the staging area and attach Derufin to it.
cards.back_text: Forced: At the beginning of each round, the players must choose: each player skips the next planning phase, or heroes do not collect resources during the resource phase this round.

cards.name: The Shadow Host
cards.text: When Revealed: Starting with the first player, each player searches the encounter deck and discard pile for 1 Oathbreaker enemy, reveals it, and adds it to the staging area. Add the Lord of the Dead to the staging area. Shuffle the encounter deck.
cards.back_text: Players cannot place progress on this stage unless they control Derufin.  If the players defeat this stage, they have escaped the Blackroot Vale with Derufin and won the game.

cards.name: Regretful Shade
cards.text: Spectral. Surge.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Deal attacking enemy 1 additional shadow card (Dusk. 2 additional cards instead. Midnight. 3 additional cards instead).

cards.name: Derufin
cards.text: Forced: After the players travel to The Stone of Erech, the first player gains control of Derufin.  Dusk. Derufin gets -1 [willpower].  Midnight. Derufin gets -2 [willpower].  If Derufin leaves play, the players lose the game.

cards.name: Murmurs of Dread
cards.text: When Revealed: All character get -1 [willpower] until the end of the round.
cards.shadow: Shadow: Dusk/Midnight. Attacking enemy makes an additional attack after this one. Midnight. This effect cannot be canceled.

cards.name: Blackroot Graves
cards.text: Forced: When Blackroot Graves is explored, return the topmost Undead enemy in the encounter discard pile to play, engaged with the first player.
cards.shadow: Shadow: If defending character has 0 [willpower], deal 2 damage to that character.
